blocks.prompt: 9. Obtain the sum of all integers in the first 1000 positive integers which are neither divisible by 5 nor by 2.
blocks.explanation:
1 se 1000 tak woh numbers jama karne hain jo na 2 se divide hon na 5 se, jaise 1, 3, 7, 9, 11, 13, 17, 19, ... Inhein seedha jama karna mushkil hai kyunke yeh A.P. nahi bante.
Diya kya hai? Pehle 1000 positive integers.
Find kya karna hai? Un numbers ka jama jo na 2 se divisible hain na 5 se.
Plan: ulta raasta: sab ka jama lo, phir na-pasandeeda numbers (2 ya 5 se divisible) ka jama nikal do. Har list A.P. hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: integers \(1, 2, \dots, 1000\).
Humein find karna hai: un ka jama jo na 2 se divide hon na 5 se.
Tareeqa: Matloob jama = (sab ka jama) − (jo 2 ya 5 se divide hon un ka jama). Ek baarik baat: 10, 20, 30, ... jaise numbers 2 se bhi divide hote hain aur 5 se bhi. Agar hum 2 ke multiples bhi minus karein aur 5 ke multiples bhi, to yeh 10 ke multiples do dafa minus ho jayenge. Is liye inhein ek dafa wapas jorna hoga.

1 se 1000 tak sab ka jama
\[S = \dfrac{1000}{2}(1 + 1000)\]
\[= 500 \times 1001 = 500500\]
Kyun: \(1, 2, \dots, 1000\) ek A.P. hai jis mein 1000 terms, pehli 1 aur aakhri 1000. \(\frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) lagaya.

2 ke multiples ka jama
\[2 + 4 + \dots + 1000\]
\[n = 500\]
\[S_2 = \dfrac{500}{2}(2 + 1000)\]
\[= 250 \times 1002 = 250500\]
Kyun: 1000 tak har doosra number even hai, to \(1000 \div 2 = 500\) even numbers hain. Yeh A.P. hai, \(d = 2\).

5 ke multiples ka jama
\[5 + 10 + \dots + 1000\]
\[n = 200\]
\[S_5 = \dfrac{200}{2}(5 + 1000)\]
\[= 100 \times 1005 = 100500\]
Kyun: 1000 tak 5 ke \(1000 \div 5 = 200\) multiples hain, aur yeh A.P. hai jis mein \(d = 5\).

10 ke multiples ka jama
\[10 + 20 + \dots + 1000\]
\[n = 100\]
\[S_{10} = \dfrac{100}{2}(10 + 1000)\]
\[= 50 \times 1010 = 50500\]
Kyun: Jo number 2 aur 5 dono se divide ho, woh 10 se divide hota hai. Yeh numbers upar wali dono lists mein shamil hain, isi liye inka jama alag chahiye.

2 ya 5 se divisible numbers ka jama
\[S_2 + S_5 - S_{10}\]
\[= 250500 + 100500 - 50500\]
\[= 300500\]
Kyun: \(S_2 + S_5\) mein 10 ke multiples do dafa gine gaye, is liye \(S_{10}\) ek dafa minus kiya. Yeh "inclusion-exclusion" (shamil karo, phir doosri dafa wala nikalo) ka usool hai.
Dhyan dein: \(S_{10}\) ko minus karna bhool jayein to jawab 149500 aata hai, jo ghalat hai.

Matloob jama
\[500500 - 300500 = 200000\]
Kyun: Kul jama mein se woh sab numbers nikal diye jo 2 ya 5 se divide hote hain; baqi sirf woh bache jo kisi se divide nahi hote.

Tasdeeq: doosra tareeqa
Odd numbers: \(1 + 3 + \dots + 999 = 500^2 = 250000\)
Odd multiples of 5: \(5 + 15 + \dots + 995\)
\[= \dfrac{100}{2}(5 + 995) = 50000\]
\[250000 - 50000 = 200000 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: "2 se divide na ho" ka matlab hai odd number. Pehle 500 odd numbers ka jama \(500^2\) hota hai. Phir in mein se woh nikale jo 5 se divide hote hain: 5, 15, 25, ..., 995 (100 numbers, \(d = 10\)). Wohi 200000 aaya.
